name: claude-skills
description: Claude Code plugins by Dominik Voda: Czech disc golf (ceskydiscgolf.cz) tournament tools, Google Sheets/Drive/Forms/Gmail and Facebook Pages access.

plugins.name: ceskydiscgolf
plugins.description: ceskydiscgolf.cz (iDiscGolf) pro ředitele turnajů: turnaje, hráči, výsledky, propozice, flighty na přání, info e-mail hráčům, report z turnaje na Facebook, uzavření turnaje s rozhozy z Tagovačky.

plugins.name: google
plugins.description: Google Sheets and Drive (read-only), Google Forms (create and edit) and Gmail (read + send with confirmation) via your own OAuth client.

plugins.name: facebook
plugins.description: Facebook Pages via the Meta Graph API: read a page's posts and schedule new ones, with your own page token.
